shaped2 is the unchanged net_control.py per-direction 2 Mbit/s gateway shaping (cloud band / edge band); not a combined bidirectional cap and not a measured physical topology. Shared-bottleneck claim only if the two-flow check verified it.
Link costs are application-path probe RTTs (HTTP/relay overhead included), not pure network times; nested reply bytes are a small-response approximation inside each hop RTT.
Policy labels selecting the same placement share ONE observation (aliases), never independent samples.
No Resource Advisor/JCT or physical topology validation claim.

Quantile uncertainty: exact block bootstrap over the temporal blocks (all C(2B-1,B) multisets of blocks, 6435 for B=8). Eight blocks give a coarse interval that tends to under-cover; the p95 of at most 64 pooled observations rests on its few largest values, so its interval is especially rough. Blocks share the same warm processes: no process/hardware replication.
